title: מעבר לחנויות: DTC, רגולציה ו-Supercell מנסה שוב | Ben's Weekly Digest
summary: Supercell's Mo Co continues to underperform despite a recent reboot, struggling with broad player retention beyond a niche audience. This raises concerns about its scalability and Supercell's ability to consistently launch new global hits, especially given its low revenue compared to previously canceled projects.
